interpretation: Descriptive finite spacing comparison only; not an IID KS test and not evidence for a limiting local law.
reference: GOE Wigner surmise P(s)=(pi s/2) exp(-pi s^2/4)
methodology_warning: Polynomial unfolding and pooled gaps induce dependence; no textbook IID-KS critical value or pass/fail label is justified.
matrix_convention: Eigenvalues are taken from the full complex Hermitian matrix M+M^*. Entrywise real projection is forbidden.
